RetryOrder.offered_or_retired.detail: A nonempty infinite execution of the runtime retry core adds a new session on every step while three old sessions remain live. Actual scan/reconcile steps preserve uniqueness and supply unbounded eligible vacant-reservation opportunities; the third original session is served in the first three opportunities. A second kernel instance uses actual ByteArray session/address types with proved lawful equality. This is not a full Node/native execution or proof that those opportunities recur there.
